replacements.Tres tipos de memoria, tres lógicas dist: Three types of memory, three different mechanisms
replacements.Ventana larga ≠ memoria viva ≠ aprendiza: Long context ≠ persistent memory ≠ permanent learning. Confusing them creates false expectations about what an agent can remember and when.
replacements.Lo que está activo en la ventana ahora m: What is active in the context window right now
replacements.Se borra al terminar la sesión: Usually disappears when the active session ends
replacements.Coste computacional crece con el tamaño: Compute cost grows with context size
replacements.El modelo \"ve\" todo lo que hay en la v: The model can use everything in the active window, but it does not learn or retain it persistently.
replacements.Lo que se recupera de fuera en tiempo de: What is retrieved from outside the model at use time
replacements.Escala a millones de documentos: Can scale to millions of documents
replacements.El modelo no \"recuerda\" documentos; lo: The model does not intrinsically remember documents; it can use them when retrieval brings them into context. Retrieval can fail.
replacements.Lo que el modelo incorporó durante el en: What the model encoded during training
replacements.Congelado: no aprende nada nuevo en uso: Frozen at inference: ordinary use does not update it
replacements.Sujeto a alucinaciones y corte de datos: Subject to hallucinations and training-data cutoff
replacements.Lo que el modelo \"sabe\" intrínsecament: What the model knows through its parameters. Updating those parameters requires a training or weight-update process.
replacements.Ampliar la ventana de contexto no convie: Expanding the context window does not turn immediate context into persistent memory. Retrieving documents with RAG does not mean the model has learned their contents either. These are three different mechanisms with different properties.
